# Spotpuls (https://spotpuls.app)
> Open European Day-Ahead Electricity Spot Price Tracker, Self-Learning 7-Day Regional Forecast (40 Bidding Zones), Postal Grid Tariff Calculator & Free Public REST API.

## Overview
Spotpuls (`https://spotpuls.app`) provides live hourly day-ahead electricity spot prices together with a dedicated self-learning 7-day (168 h) hourly forecast and probability range for every European spot-electricity bidding zone across 28 native languages.

## Public REST API (Free, No API Key, CORS `*`)
- **Primary Endpoint (JSON / CSV / SVG Badge)**:
  - `GET https://spotpuls.app/api/v1/prices?zone=FI&vat=1&currency=local&format=json`
  - Query parameters:
    - `zone`: One of 40 European bidding zones: `FI`, `SE1`, `SE2`, `SE3`, `SE4`, `NO1`, `NO2`, `NO3`, `NO4`, `NO5`, `DK1`, `DK2`, `EE`, `LV`, `LT`, `DE-LU`, `AT`, `CH`, `NL`, `BE`, `FR`, `GB`, `IE-SEM`, `ES`, `PT`, `IT-North`, `IT-Centre-North`, `IT-Centre-South`, `IT-South`, `IT-Sicily`, `IT-Sardinia`, `PL`, `CZ`, `SK`, `HU`, `RO`, `BG`, `SI`, `HR`, `GR`.
    - `vat`: `1` (incl. national electricity VAT, default) or `0` (VAT 0 %).
    - `currency`: `local` (native subunit/kWh, e.g. `snt/kWh`, `öre/kWh`, `øre/kWh`, `ct/kWh`, `p/kWh`, `gr/kWh`, `Kč/kWh`, `Ft/kWh`), `eur_cents` (`c/kWh`), or `eur_mwh` (`EUR/MWh`).
    - `format`: `json` (default), `csv` (for Google Sheets `=IMPORTDATA(...)` & Excel), or `badge` (live embeddable SVG price badge).
- **List All 40 Bidding Zones**:
  - `GET https://spotpuls.app/api/v1/zones` (or `GET https://spotpuls.app/api/v1/prices?list=zones`)
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: `https://spotpuls.app/openapi.json`
- **Interactive Developer Documentation**: `https://spotpuls.app/api-docs/`
